responsibility.title: Keep shop-api answering in production
responsibility.text: Keep shop-api answering in production. If it stops answering, or answers wrongly, find out why, fix it, release the fix, tell every customer the event reached, and make the same event visible or impossible the next time. You deploy and write to the customer yourself. Ask me first about a refund of more than 50 EUR, or anything that changes the price.

last_case.title: The render queue stopped for 6 minutes
last_case.note: Back to normal and the customer answered.

steps.text: Queue stopped 02:14 to 02:20 UTC. No customer request was lost.
Restarted the worker and pinned its memory. Commit 7b2e0d1.
In production at 02:31 UTC.
Nobody to tell: no request failed in those six minutes.
Nothing to put right.
A check now watches the queue depth and wakes me above 50.
The check ran green for three days.
502 from 09:12 to 09:26 UTC. Every request to /v1/render failed; 41 requests, 6 customers.
The render worker ran out of file handles. Raised the limit and closed the leak. Commit a4f19c2.
Deployed to production at 09:41 UTC and watched it for ten minutes.

marker.detail: Studio last put its duties in order 3 days ago.
